# jikeyan-agent-skill

> Official agent skills + MCP server for 极科研 (jikeyan), a local-first iOS
> kanban app for research project tracking. Lets an AI agent manage research
> projects, deadlines, waiting items, submissions, and review rounds via a
> documented Agent API. Keys stay in the user's environment; patient data is
> never accepted by the API.
>
> 中文摘要：极科研官方智能体 Skill + MCP 服务。让 AI 智能体（Claude Code、
> Codex、Qwen、Trae、CodeBuddy、通义灵码等）帮你做科研项目管理：项目进度、
> 投稿、审稿回复、等待项跟进。服务端在国内、无需代理；支持本机 stdio 与
> Skill 文件安装；云端 Agent（扣子、百炼、Kimi、智谱）需远程 MCP 端点。
> 密钥只放环境变量，不进仓库；患者隐私数据接口直接拒收。

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/README.md): value proposition, 3-step setup, client install snippets
- [中文说明](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese version of the README
- [Agent API online guide](https://api.jikeyan.cn/agent.md): auth, endpoints, errors, compliance (authoritative)
- [MCP package](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/mcp/README.md): install, config, 17 tools, privacy
- [Distribution notes](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/docs/distribution.md): registry formats and manual submission checklist

## Skills

- [jikeyan-agent SKILL.md](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/plugins/jikeyan/skills/jikeyan-agent/SKILL.md): Agent API cookbook (schema-first, versioned writes, dry_run)
- [jikeyan-agent endpoints](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/plugins/jikeyan/skills/jikeyan-agent/references/endpoints.md): endpoint table for the agent key scope
- [jikeyan-agent shell helper](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/plugins/jikeyan/skills/jikeyan-agent/scripts/jikeyan.sh): curl wrapper using `JIKEYAN_AGENT_KEY`
- [jikeyan-academic-colleague SKILL.md](https://github.com/871922384/jikeyan-agent-skill/blob/main/plugins/jikeyan/skills/jikeyan-academic-colleague/SKILL.md): daily/weekly review, stalled detection, waiting-item follow-up, review response, pre-submission checks
